# Work management blocks

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-references.ts from the block manifests. -->

The Work management blocks of this version of better-supabase, from the block manifests. Install one with `npx better-supabase add <block>`; the docs page of each block has the method signatures. Entity names are the defaults; an app can rename them under `blocks.<name>.names`.

## tags

Tenant tags with a kind, and a link from a tag to a subject. Over the app's tables it can use one link table per subject.

- Title: Tags
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/tags
- Client: `tagsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/tags`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `outbox`, `drive`, `subjects`, `bulk-actions`
- Entities: `tag`
- Tables: `tags`
- Permission keys: `tags.manage`, `tags.read`, `tags.apply`
- Events (`TagsEvents`): `subject.tagged`, `subject.untagged`, `tag.created`, `tag.deleted`, `tag.updated`

## state-machine

Allowed status transitions as the caller, a history row and a status.changed event. A machine can also write a stages timeline and keep a lifecycle row (pause, flags, pinned version). Each machine is a subject table named in options.machines, or a config.recordTypes type.

- Title: State machine
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/state-machine
- Client: `stateMachineBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/state-machine`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `approvals`, `workflow-editor`, `bulk-actions`

## custom-fields

Field definitions, options and typed values. A sensitive value is readable only with the field's permission. Inline layout stores the definition on the value row.

- Title: Custom fields
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/custom-fields
- Client: `customFieldsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/custom-fields`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `outbox`, `field-encryption`, `audit`, `subjects`, `legal-entities`, `imports`
- Entities: `field_definition`
- Tables: `field_definitions`
- Permission keys: `custom_fields.manage`, `custom_fields.read`, `custom_fields.read_sensitive`
- Events (`CustomFieldsEvents`): `field_definition.archived`, `field_definition.created`, `field_definition.purged`, `field_definition.restored`, `field_definition.updated`, `field_value.deleted`, `field_value.set`
- Provides: `customFields`

## saved-views

Named, ranked list states (filters, sort, columns, grouping, density) for one user, a team or the whole tenant.

- Title: Saved views
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/saved-views
- Client: `savedViewsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/saved-views`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `outbox`, `teams`, `collections`
- Entities: `saved_view`
- Tables: `saved_views`
- Permission keys: `saved_views.read`, `saved_views.share`
- Events (`SavedViewsEvents`): `saved_view.created`, `saved_view.deleted`, `saved_view.updated`

## relations

Typed links between subjects (blocks, parent, relates, or your own kinds), with inverse names, cycle checks, one-target kinds, walks and rollups.

- Title: Relations
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/relations
- Client: `relationsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/relations`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `outbox`, `bulk-actions`
- Entities: `relation`
- Tables: `relations`
- Permission keys: `relations.read`, `relations.manage`
- Events (`RelationsEvents`): `subject.linked`, `subject.unlinked`

## bulk-actions

One action over many rows: up to a limit in one call with a result per row, and larger sets as a background run on the jobs queue that runs as the user who started it.

- Title: BulkActions actions
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/bulk-actions
- Client: `bulkActionsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/bulk-actions`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `queue`, `outbox`
- Events (`BulkActionsEvents`): `bulk_run.completed`

## search

A search_documents index kept up by triggers from each config.recordTypes search entry, with search(q) as the caller (websearch, trigram prefixes, can_subject, hybrid with embeddings), search_page for browsing and cursor paging with facet filters, and recents and favorites from the share-links user state.

- Title: Search
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/search
- Client: `searchBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/search`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`
- Works with: `share-links`, `vector-search`
- Provides: `sink`

## approvals

Approval requests with steps per subject type and action: approvers by permission, role, team, user or the requester's manager, a required count, delegation, expiry and reminders. Tenants tighten the configured policies with conditions and a confirm or authorize mode, and an approval is consumed once against a request fingerprint. The final approval runs a state-machine transition or a job.

- Title: Approvals
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/approvals
- Client: `approvalsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/approvals`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `housekeeping`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `notifications`, `queue`, `drive`, `teams`, `state-machine`, `employees`, `automations`, `housekeeping`, `subjects`
- Entities: `approval`
- Tables: `approval_requests`
- Permission keys: `approvals.read`, `approvals.request`, `approvals.manage`
- Events (`ApprovalsEvents`): `approval.approved`, `approval.cancelled`, `approval.consumed`, `approval.delegated`, `approval.escalated`, `approval.expired`, `approval.rejected`, `approval.requested`

## pipelines

Tenant-editable pipelines for any registered subject: ordered stages whose categories map to open, success or failure, a stage history with time in stage, board totals per currency and a status mapping that runs through state-machine.

- Title: Pipelines
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/pipelines

- Modes: `managed`, `custom`

- Entities: `pipeline`
- Tables: `pipelines`
- Permission keys: `pipelines.read`, `pipelines.manage`
- Events (`PipelinesEvents`): `pipeline.archived`, `pipeline.created`, `pipeline.restored`, `pipeline.updated`, `pipeline_stage.archived`, `pipeline_stage.created`, `pipeline_stage.restored`, `pipeline_stage.updated`

## tasks

Issues and tasks on pipelines: identifiers, parents without cycles, several assignees, priority 0 to 4, estimates, start, end and due dates, locking, projects, iterations, batched edits and a progress tree.

- Title: Work items
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/tasks
- Client: `tasksBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/tasks`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`, `pipelines`
- Works with: `outbox`, `notifications`, `numbering`, `attachments`, `reminders`, `accounting`, `option-sets`, `templates`, `tags`, `catalog`, `pipelines`, `subjects`
- Entities: `task`, `project`, `iteration`, `checklist_item`
- Tables: `tasks`, `projects`, `iterations`, `task_checklist_items`
- Permission keys: `tasks.read`, `tasks.write`, `tasks.manage`
- Events (`TasksEvents`): `task.archived`, `task.assigned`, `task.closed`, `task.created`, `task.deleted`, `task.reopened`, `task.restored`, `task.updated`
- Consumes: `customFields (optional)`

## collections

Favorites (a member's ranked stars on any registered record), lists (named, static collections of one subject type owned by a user, a team or the organization) and saved items (a member's records to come back to, with a note and a reminder), with entries hidden unless the caller can read their record.

- Title: Collections
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/collections
- Client: `collectionsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/collections`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`
- Works with: `outbox`, `teams`, `bulk-actions`
- Entities: `subject_collection`
- Tables: `subject_collections`
- Permission keys: `collections.read`, `collections.write`, `collections.share`
- Events (`CollectionsEvents`): `collection.archived`, `collection.created`, `collection.entry_added`, `collection.entry_removed`, `collection.restored`, `saved_item.reminded`
- Consumes: `notifier (optional)`

## assets

- Title: Assets and locations

- Client: `assetsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/assets`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`

- Entities: `asset`, `asset_location`
- Tables: `assets`, `asset_locations`
- Permission keys: `assets.read`, `assets.manage`, `assets.assign`
- Events (`AssetsEvents`): `asset.assigned`, `asset.created`, `asset.depreciated`, `asset.disposed`, `asset.released`, `asset.updated`, `asset_location.archived`, `asset_location.created`, `asset_location.restored`, `asset_location.updated`

## cases

Cases per organization: nonconformities, complaints, incidents, near misses, observations, improvements, change requests and audit findings of tenant-editable kinds, numbered per kind, each kind on its own pipeline, with a root cause, containment and corrective actions as work items, an effectiveness check, public intake through forms, and a close guard that refuses to close while a blocker remains.

- Title: Cases
